title: compile-time-data-contracts: three carriers, one bit, compile-time data contracts for Scala and Spark schema equality
description: A Scala macro that decides declared structural conformance between a producer case class and a contract case class under a named compatibility policy, before the build completes, with a policy-aware runtime pin at the Spark sink and an opt-in row-level check for the optionality question a read schema can no longer answer. The compile-time engine is cross-built for Scala 2.13 and Scala 3 and carries no Spark dependency; the Spark half targets Spark 3.5.x. Ships with a 2668-cell comparison of four schema-equality predicate owners, the harnesses that produced it, and the saved benchmark runs. Scope is declared structural compatibility only. It does not claim semantic contracts, value-level correctness, production incident reduction, or broad industrial performance results.
